Check.description:
Arms a fresh poll when one was lost: due when the armed one was, or at once when that passed. Does nothing with no
work left.
Check.title: Check

Poll.description: The actor's own timer: only the armed one acts, by taking one step toward the goal. Any other is ignored.
Poll.title: Poll

Remove.description:
Stops the container if needed, records its end, then removes it. Send it before deleting the actor, or the
container stays.
Remove.title: Remove

Start.description:
Runs the container until it ends, and sends the end to `to`. The first `Start` sets the target; a later one
changes nothing, unless the container has ended: then it sends the saved end to its own target at once.

messageType.description:
The message type of the end, whose payload is `{"key": …, "end": …}`, a [`ContainerEnded`]; not empty, at
most 200 characters, without NUL. The target's registry is checked only when the end is sent.

Start.title: Start

Stop.description: Stops the container and ends it `stopped`, or `timedOut` past its deadline; one never started is never created.
Stop.title: Stop

ContainerEnd.description:
The end of a container: saved in the state and sent to the target in the commit that records it, before anything
removes the container.

code.description: The exit code, when the runtime gave one.

logs.description:
The tail of its output, stdout and stderr together: at most the settings' last lines and bytes, without NUL;
empty when nothing was made, or `(no logs: …)` when they could not be read.

reason.description: Why, in words: at most 1 KiB, without NUL.

EndTarget.description: Where the end goes: the target and message type of the first `Start`.

messageType.description: The message type, whose payload is a [`ContainerEnded`].

Goal.description: What is wanted of a container; it moves only forward.

oneOf.description: Removed, after its end is recorded.
The program exited by itself, with its code.

The runtime ended it, or it could not be run: it did not start, ran out of memory, went missing, the runtime
failed too often in a row, or its key, request or spec was refused.
It ran past its deadline and was stopped.
It was stopped on request, or never made.
Nothing made yet, or made by a step whose commit was lost.

Run.description: The request of a test container.

state.description:
The state of a container actor: the host's typed request, never a spec, and the reconciliation's progress. Create it
with [`ContainerState::new`]; a decoded state is checked the same way.

armed.description: The id of the armed poll; absent or null when none is armed.

deadline.description: The deadline of a running container; absent or null without a timeout.

due.description: When the armed poll is due; present exactly with `armed`.

end.description: The end; present exactly once ended or removed.

errors.description: Runtime errors in a row; absent: 0.

goal.description:
Run, stop or remove; absent or null before the first `Start`, `Stop` or `Remove`, and set in any other phase
than new.

phase.description: New, started, ended or removed; absent: new.

request.description: The host's request, from which its job builds the spec at each create.

target.description: Where the end goes; absent or null before the first `Start`.

undelivered.description: Why the end could not be sent; absent or null when it was, or was not yet.

state.title: ContainerState
